jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Slug

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/slugpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestSlug_Match(t *testing.T) {
	var s Slug
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"hello-world"`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(s) != "hello-world" {
		t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", string(s), "hello-world")
	}
}

func TestSlug_NoMatch(t *testing.T) {
	var s Slug
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"Hello World"`), &s)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want pattern rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "does not match pattern") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want pattern-rejection message", err)
	}
}
